lines.quote: During my final-year research at YDIT, I designed and simulated a 16-element uniform linear array beamformer for a phased-array weather radar prototype.

Designed and implemented a real-time pulse-compression matched filter in C/C++ running on the ARM Cortex-R5 core of a Zynq UltraScale+ SoC. DMA-driven sample transfer from the ADC FIFO, validated against a 50 µs hard deadline. Currently deployed in Boreal's prototype rangefinder hardware.

Wrote and maintain a Python pipeline (pytest suite, GitLab CI) that processes raw RF sweep data, computes per-channel correction tables, and flashes them to instrument firmware via serial. In daily use by the three other engineers in the sensor group since mid-2025.

RF front-end characterisation and calibration for the L-band receive chain: conducted S-parameter and noise-figure measurements using Keysight PNA-X network analysers in Boreal's in-house test facility.
